grouping_rule: issue_id = 'ISS-' + topic for every completed record whose intent is complaint or cancellation; one issue per review

issues.name: Users unable to log in or connect
issues.description: The examples describe users being blocked from their accounts, whether by rejected passwords or failed connections over Wi-Fi.

issues.name: Frequent ads and removed music player features
issues.description: The examples share complaints that ads interrupt playback too often and that recent updates removed or restricted features, with several users saying they are leaving the app.

issues.name: Music playback stops, skips, or won't start
issues.description: The examples report playlists that show as playing but produce no sound, songs that stop partway without resuming, inability to replay or seek back a few seconds, and restrictions on skipping or choosing tracks for non-premium users.

issues.name: Offline downloads stall and fail to complete
issues.description: Both examples describe downloads not working properly, with offline playback failing and songs getting stuck while downloading in the background until the app is reopened.

issues.name: Missing songs and inconsistent lyrics availability
issues.description: Several reviewers report that songs they look for are absent from the catalog or that lyrics appear for some tracks but not others, making the library feel incomplete and unreliable.

issues.name: Core features locked behind premium paywall
issues.description: The examples complain that after an update, basic playback controls such as queueing, skipping, and shuffle are restricted to premium, making the free experience feel useless.

issues.name: support problems
issues.description: contacting support, response time, quality of support answers

issues.name: Vague negative reviews after recent update
issues.description: The examples are short, generic complaints calling the app bad or useless, with some tying the dissatisfaction to a recent update, but none specify a concrete feature or failure.
